$meta.about: Rep engine golden vectors (docs/notes/REP_COUNTER_CONTRACT.md). Replay each trace with traceDigest(trace) and compare with expect: count, rep timings, fault events and angleHash (FNV-1a 32 over the little-endian IEEE-754 bytes of the smoothed angle after every pushed sample, 0xff×8 for null).

vectors.name: pushups
vectors.about: 5 push-ups, ±3° noise and a 70° landmark flip every 13 samples

vectors.name: squats
vectors.about: 3 deep squats and one above parallel (counts, depth hint), ±3° noise, flips every 17 samples

vectors.name: cheat-supine-press

vectors.name: paused-session
vectors.about: 3 push-ups, one inside a pause window, a hold, one with a 300 ms dropout, one more
